newsitem.title: USA: Mark IV to buy back up to 7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Mark IV to buy back up to 7 mln shrs.

text.p: Mark IV Industries Inc said Wednesday it had approved the repurchase of up to seven million shares, or about 11 percent of its 63.2 million shares outstanding.
The company said the stock will be purchased in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions, at prices Mark IV considers attractive.
It is expected that the repurchase program will span a 12-month period, commencing immediately, the company said.
Funding for the buyback will come from a portion of the proceeds from the sale of non-core businesses, and earnings generated over the period involved, Mark IV said.
The company recently said it had realized $313 million from the sale of several non-core businesses.

Mark IV is a global manufacturing company headquartered in Amherst, N.Y. Its core technologies include power transmission, fluid transfer and filtration systems, and components for global industrial and automotive markets.
